title: Add Request ID Middleware for Traceability
description: Introduce a lightweight middleware that generates a unique request ID for every incoming HTTP request, attaches it to the request and response objects, and adds it to response headers. This enables consistent tracing across logs and downstream services, improving debugging and observability.
testCases: Should generate a UUID v4 request ID and attach it to req.id and res.setHeader('X-Request-Id')
Should preserve an existing X-Request-Id header from the client instead of generating a new one
Should make the request ID available in the logger via a global context or request object
acceptance: All tests pass, request IDs are unique per request, existing client-supplied IDs are respected, and the ID is included in response headers and accessible to downstream middleware/loggers without breaking existing routes or error handling.
reason: Provides essential observability for production deployments, simplifies debugging, and aligns yantraverse with best‑practice tracing patterns without adding external dependencies.
